data_status: 200 clips across 18 fieldsites; every clip was already spent by an earlier registered experiment
audit_corrections: discard the first spectral-flux frame because its zero value is extractor initialization, not an auditory observation
exclude duration-normalized edge bins when checking whether a phase result is driven by clip boundaries
compare phase and mean-reversion candidates with the best persistence, EMA, and causal running-mean baseline
fit acoustic-state codebooks without the held-out fieldsite and reserve a two-second unlabeled prefix for clip normalization

duration_normalized_phase_template.best_audited_setting: 0.10 blend, interior bins 4 through 27, log spectral flux
duration_normalized_phase_template.note: The initial 198/200 result was driven by deterministic flux warm-up and clip-end decay.

bounded_local_velocity.best_observed_case: log spectral flux, one frame, learning rate 0.05

fixed_mean_reversion.note: Every interpolation was worse on average than the better persistence/EMA endpoint.

quantized_acoustic_state_transitions.note: The apparent transition ceiling depends on batch codebook optimization; the bounded one-pass local learner does not retain it.

decision: Do not implement or preregister any audited candidate. A fresh Stage-3 attempt needs a different observation protocol or a locally learnable representation, not more tuning on these clips.
claim_boundary: This is a negative spent-data design audit. It consumes no fresh evidence and does not alter the positive bounded phase-template result or the safe-but-not-superior online learner result.
